mechanics.name: Four-directional player movement
mechanics.description: ACTION1–ACTION4 translate the player unit by 5 cells along the four axes: ACTION1 moves (-5,0), ACTION2 (+5,0), ACTION3 (0,-5), ACTION4 (0,+5). ACTION1 is the dominant/most-used move (8/9 transitions).

mechanics.name: Linked player unit (color 9 + color 12 move together)
mechanics.description: The color-9 object (~15px) and the color-12 object (~10px) always translate by the identical vector on every action, behaving as one rigid player entity rather than independent objects.

mechanics.name: Per-step progress counter grows
mechanics.description: A small color-3 marker (obj#16/#17) grows by exactly +2 cells on every action regardless of direction, monotonically increasing (2→4→6→…→24). Acts as a step/move counter or filling progress bar.

mechanics.name: Per-step resource/timer depletes
mechanics.description: A color-11 object (obj#17/#18) shrinks by exactly -2 cells on every action regardless of direction, monotonically decreasing (82→80→…→60). Acts as a countdown timer or depleting resource paired inversely with the color-3 counter.

mechanics.name: Large color-3 region reshapes each step
mechanics.description: The large color-3 object (obj#2, ~892px) registers a 'grew shape change' on nearly every action, indicating a continuously redrawn/filled region (e.g. a trail, flood-fill, or path) tied to player motion.

mechanics.name: Color-3 object splitting and mass transfer
mechanics.description: Large color-3 mass moves between objects: obj#2 shrinks -820 while a new obj#6 (820px) appears (split), and repeated ±25-cell exchanges occur between two color-3 objects (one grows +25 as the other shrinks -25), conserving total mass across the pair.

mechanics.name: Collision consumption of color-5 object
mechanics.description: When the player reaches it, a color-5 object (obj#3, 38px) shrinks -5 cells, suggesting the player eats/erodes color-5 targets on contact.

mechanics.name: No-op / blocked action
mechanics.description: An action can produce a 'static' transition with no object changes, indicating movement into a wall/boundary or an otherwise invalid move is a no-op.

changes.name: player_movement
changes.description: Model the linked player entity (color-9 ~15px object + color-12 ~10px object) as one rigid unit that translates by a fixed vector on each action: ACTION1 (-5,0), ACTION2 (+5,0), ACTION3 (0,-5), ACTION4 (0,+5). Both objects move by the identical vector every action. This is the foundational mechanic (ACTION1 dominates, 8/9 moves) that all other per-step effects hang off of.
